prioritizedBatches.name: 1. Common compositor pointwise graph operations
prioritizedBatches.scope: Port newly discovered shared typed utilities: Boolean/Integer/Compare inputs and math, menu/switch handling, vector/rotation/matrix operations, strings and graph composition. Function/Geometry class names alone do not imply shading support.

prioritizedBatches.name: 2. Close modes and parameter domains of existing live nodes
prioritizedBatches.scope: Remaining shader color modes, image sampling/projection/alpha domains, generated/GPU object-instance metadata and color/index property timelines; finish unsupported native GPU filter models and remaining parameter restrictions.

prioritizedBatches.name: 3. Procedural textures and coordinate/geometry inputs
prioritizedBatches.scope: Gabor/Sky/IES, remaining Noise/Voronoi features and scale bands, vector transforms/tangents/geometry attributes and bump/displacement conventions; distinguish exact, bounded approximation and static capture.

prioritizedBatches.name: 4. Spatial compositor and render-pass pipeline
prioritizedBatches.scope: Additional Blur/Glare kernels, transforms/crop/scale, masks, dilation/erosion, lens distortion, defocus/vector blur, denoise, multilayer/AOV/cryptomatte sources. These need image-domain sampling, buffers or temporal integration, not class-name aliases.

prioritizedBatches.name: 5. Full surface/light/volume behavior
prioritizedBatches.scope: Additional BSDFs, anisotropy/subsurface/hair/volumes, ray queries and Blender 5.3 light-evaluation nodes; preserve lighting/geometry dependencies and state explicitly where browser rendering cannot reproduce native path-traced semantics.

prioritizedBatches.name: 6. Time, file/media, color-management and graph execution
prioritizedBatches.scope: Driven/animated graph parameters, image/movie/sequence inputs, OSL/custom nodes, OCIO conversions and full graph combinations; add dependency tracking, lifecycle, diagnostics and versioned evidence before calling them live supported.
